name: PricingCard
summary: Single tier on a pricing page. Composes a plan name, price (with billing cadence + sub-line), feature list with check / cross glyphs, and a CTA. Includes 'highlight' variant for the recommended tier with the v0.12.5 peak-end lift (accent glow + lifted shadow). One highlighted tier per pricing surface (per Premium Psychology principle 3).

price.description: The headline price. Render with tabular-nums.

features.description: Array of { label, included? }. Renders check / cross icons.

highlight.description: Renders the recommended-tier surface with accent glow + lift. One per surface.

badge.description: Top-right badge — 'Most popular' / 'Best value' / '14-day free trial'.

rules: Highlight tier additionally announces 'Recommended plan' via sr-only.
Feature list: <ul role='list'>; each item with Check or X icon paired with screen-reader-friendly 'Included' / 'Not included'.
Price renders in tabular-nums so columns align across cards.

do: One highlight per surface. Two = no highlight.
Peak-end lift on highlight (v0.12.5): shadow.glow.accent + slight Y translation on hover (-1 px).
Lead with the plan name in type.heading.h3.
Render price in type.heading.h1, tabular-nums, with cadence in muted type.body.sm.
Use Check (text.accent) for included; X (text.tertiary) for not included — never lime for not-included.
dont: Don't highlight more than one tier — the user must know what to pick.
Don't paint the entire card surface in lime; only the badge + glow + ring carry the accent.
Don't write feature labels in marketing-speak — operator language matches the rest of the system.

changelog.note: Initial PricingCard contract. v0.12.5 peak-end lift on highlight.
